name: Enlil
source:
A mysterious stranger appearing in unexpected places. A person wrapped in mysteries.

[spoiler]Current head of net RPG "Babylon's" administering body and one of the game's founding members. Also the leader of terrorist organization "Code". Real name is Izumo Tsukasa.[/spoiler]
